cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2); prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine (5); no reinforcing route. No Parfum; first listed preservative Sodium Benzoate (8) is the E3 point. Laureth-9 (3) is a fatty-alcohol ethoxylate (solubilizer/polidocanol), assigned to the not-a-route/not-a-buffer class; counting it as a nonionic buffer would not change the value.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Single buffer listed after Sodium Chloride (4) argues toward strong, but C1 fixes moderate with one prominent buffer.

formulaFacts.role: humectant; E4 comfort and humectant route

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful conditioning system: prominent Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (7) with humectants Urea (6), Glycerin (9), Panthenol (14). No silicone, payload lipid or pearlizer, so C2 is not met.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Otherwise cleansing-led; guar is the only substantive route.
